approved: Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment (Finance) Bill 2013

Moved the Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment (Finance) Bill 2013, which would allow special dividends and adjustments to callable capital, implement a 2012 budget measure, and respond to the Productivity Commission's findings on surplus capital and EFIC's future mandate.
Argued that the bill would enable a $200 million special dividend from EFIC, criticised the government's budget management and spending, and said the coalition did not oppose the measure.
Noted that no Labor speakers had defended the Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment (Finance) Bill 2013 and suggested the minister might respond.

Argued that taking $200 million from EFIC would reduce support for Australian exporters, criticised the government's economic management and taxes, and said the bill would weaken manufacturing and small-business export opportunities.
Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment (Finance) Act 2013
